limitations: This descriptor grants no production storage guarantees and has no conformance claims.
Actual Windows SYMLINK A05 and executable/dependency lifetime G01 remain NOT_VERIFIED; no policy or privilege workaround.
Software roles: file_create.v1 one exclusive effect up to 1 MiB with existing parents; publish_new_version.v1 one archive-first/in-place update up to the existing 16 MiB contract bound.
The connected software graph, CLI/MCP, independent native inspect, continuations and rollback require actual tests; source review is not qualification.
FULL, bundles, append, journal and Source/Knowledge admission are not qualified by this candidate.
Sampled link counts and sharing modes do not prove continuous exclusion of every external alias. Operations bind the intended objects/names/parents; existing aliases may see in-place updates.
A raw hash, origin match, Docker metadata, READY, ACK or exit code alone neither authenticates loaded code nor establishes effect success.
Accepted launcher, CPython, Docker daemon, installation data and complete source-wheel/dependency namespaces require qualified lifetime immutability, including unresolved orphan-worker lifetimes.
Historical candidate descriptors and registry snapshots are immutable and need their matching accepted artifacts; they are not rebound to the new authority source.

storage_scope.filesystem: UNQUALIFIED candidate: exact local NTFS plus own ext4 MIX evidence/preparation only.
storage_scope.mount_boundary: No native Core admission until the exact Windows/Docker/source-wheel/namespace environment has passed mandatory qualification.
